steps: Parked Spear + Dagger from StarterPack into ServerStorage
Pulled falchion references (clipped single-edge blade, cross quillons, disc pommel)
generate_mesh 'Falchion' at 3.4 studs; capture_angles confirmed blade+quillons+disc pommel silhouette
make_tool (single MeshPart Handle) and moved into StarterPack
bind_hitbox damage 20, reach 7, cooldown 0.3; verified attributes

recipe.text: Falchion - a NEW single-edged concept distinct from prior straight swords/spear/dagger. Cube prompt stressed slender single-edged blade with clipped angled tip, cross quillons, disc pommel; came back 1.1x3.4x0.2 studs, correct hand-weapon scale vs 5-stud character. Silhouette matched both references (front/iso capture: visible edge profile, quillons, round pommel) on first pass, so one capture round sufficed. save_mesh persisted before toolify; behavior/hitbox attributes read back at configured values.
